defect: The fix only raises the 'Bogus framebuffer address' message from DEBUG_LOG to ERROR_LOG.
reason: A log-level change repairs no defect; the change merely corrected a typo in that message.

defect: The fix advances decOff by DecFmtSize of the weight formats instead of nweights * 4, so u8/u16 weights no longer waste space in the decoded vertex.
reason: The over-allocation is only wasted space with consistent offsets (w1off = w0off + 8 matches DEC_U16_4), and the nweights * 4 advance predates the change, so nothing was broken.

defect: The fix adds a WM_USER_ATRAC_STATUS_CHANGED message and posts it when the AT3+ setting changes so the Win32 menu updates.
reason: This is new notification behaviour for the Atrac setting; the change's log-status enum and PostMessage are untouched and correct.

defect: The fix casts handle to u32 in the comparison with 0x80020001 to silence a signed/unsigned comparison warning.
reason: The comparison already converted handle to unsigned and behaved correctly, so the fix only removes a compiler warning.

defect: The new header, added to the CMake, MSVC and Android builds while the code did not build, declares redraw(), which is never defined but is called from ImMemView.cpp.
reason: The fix 'Fix memview build' removes the undefined redraw() declaration (with its calls) and adjusts the interface, repairing a build/link failure this commit introduced; seeing it requires ImMemView.cpp and the build files.

defect: The fix gives the ScrollView inside the later-added SearchBar container a layout weight of 1.0 so the tabs scroll.
reason: The container with a SearchBar did not exist in this change, where the ScrollView was added directly to the tab, so the scrolling problem comes from later code.

defect: The new '#ifdef __GLIBC__' guards in sceRtcConvertLocalTimeToUTC and sceRtcConvertUtcToLocalTime send Symbian, which previously used tm_gmtoff, to the '-timezone' branch that does not work there.
reason: The fix adds __SYMBIAN32__ to exactly these guards, repairing the Qt/Symbian build the change broke; knowing Symbian lacks a usable timezone global needs the platform headers.

defect: The fix adds a sampleOffset parameter to InitContext so curOff and decodePos follow a seek target, reinitializes the context on reset in full-buffer mode, and removes SeekToSample.
reason: The change only extracted InitContext from SetData with unchanged behaviour; seeking support and the streamDataByte handling were added or altered by later commits.

defect: The fix only extends the streamDataByte comment to say it is not decremented in full mode either.
reason: Comment-only change on both sides; no code defect.

defect: The change stores the extension strings in std::string members of gl_extensions, a struct that CheckGLExtensions memsets to zero, and assigns possibly-null glGetString/wglGetExtensionsStringEXT/eglQueryString results to them.
reason: The fix moves the strings to globals outside the memset struct and null-checks each source, repairing the undefined behaviour and possible crash added here; the std::string type is only visible in gl_state.h.

defect: The fix sets sz = V_Single for the 8-bit case of the pre-existing Comp_Vx2i, re-enables the vi2s path the change had disabled, and edits a comment.
reason: The real bug is in Comp_Vx2i, which this change did not touch; the change's DISABLE for vi2s only falls back to the interpreter, which is not a wrong result.

defect: The fix changes the IR metadata type strings of vector ops (F to V or 2) and adds disassembler cases so vectors print as register ranges.
reason: These type strings only drive IR disassembly text; the fix is a debug-display enhancement, not the repair of a functional defect.

defect: UpdateRenderResolution sets renderWidth=480*zoom and renderHeight=272*zoom in portrait and 272/480 in landscape, i.e. the two branches are swapped.
reason: The fix swaps exactly these branches; the inversion is evident in the diff next to the other portrait checks that use 272x480.

defect: The fix reads lastModified from parts[3] instead of parts[4].
reason: In this change the line had 5 fields and parts[4] was correct; a later commit (bd99e4a) changed the format to 4 fields without updating the index.

defect: The fix reserves right padding for a right-side icon in Choice measurement and drawing and repositions that icon.
reason: The right-icon spacing was not accounted for before or after this change, so the fix addresses a pre-existing layout gap.

defect: The change inserts __UsbGpsDoState in the middle of the 'HLE Modules' savestate section, so states saved before it no longer load.
reason: The fix moves the call to the end of the section ('Add new sections last'), repairing savestate compatibility; seeing it needs the PointerWrap section semantics.

defect: The new Back button uses UIScreen::OnBack, whose dialog result leaves EmuScreen with a black screen when backing out.
reason: The fix changes exactly this handler to OnOK so that EmuScreen handles the result; the effect depends on EmuScreen's handling of the dialog result.

defect: The fix saves and restores the callee-saved FPRs f14-f31 in the JIT prologue/epilogue and removes Break() from LFD/SFD so they can be used there.
reason: The change only added FPU emitter functions; the missing FPR save is in the pre-existing Prologue/Epilogue, and the Break() markers were deliberate placeholders.

defect: Step_TcFloatThrough drops the * 0.5f scaling of through-mode float UVs.
reason: The fix restores exactly the * 0.5f, which stays in later versions, so the change broke float UVs in through mode; seeing it needs the shader and uniform code that consumes them.

defect: The added UIContext::BeginFrame() call in the main render path is placed before the 'EmuScreen_NoFrame' backbuffer bind, so it runs (setting scissor and UI state) before the render target is bound.
reason: The fix moves this very call after the bind to fix EmuScreen after a crash; judging it needs UIContext::BeginFrame and the render manager's behaviour.

defect: The fix re-enables trunc.w.s and instead disables cvt.w.s, whose ROUND_TO_ZERO conversion ignores the current rounding mode.
reason: The miscompiled cvt.w.s predates the change; the change's DISABLE for trunc.w.s only falls back to the interpreter, which is slower but correct.

defect: The fix rewords the iOS 9 Dynarec message to say the JIT is not yet working on arm64 iOS 9.
reason: In this file only a UI string changes; the erroneous JIT disabling on armv7 iOS 9 lies in other files of the change.

defect: scePsmfPlayerCreate now returns ERROR_PSMF_NOT_FOUND instead of creating the player (reverting de1cb3f), so players are never created there and scePsmfPlayerStart falls into its broken creation path.
reason: The fix un-reverts exactly this so Create creates the player again; the diff plainly shows the create function no longer creating anything.

defect: The fix adds the S suffix to add/sub immediates, decodes arithmetic shifted-register and extended-register forms with extend names, and requires shift == 0 for plain logical output.
reason: These are disassembler completeness improvements: the S bit was not shown before the change either, and the register forms the fix reworks were pre-existing gaps or new functionality.

defect: The fix capitalizes the Russian language name in the language list.
reason: Cosmetic string change; the lowercase name also predates the change.

defect: The change uses the menu ID ID_CHEAT, which is not defined anywhere, in WndProc and UpdateCommands.
reason: The fix ('Fix Windows build') renames it to ID_EMULATION_CHEATS, repairing the compile failure; that the ID is undefined is only visible in resource.h.

defect: The fix removes the unused local 'DisplayList x;' from the GPUCommon constructor.
reason: An unused local variable is harmless; removing it is cleanup.

defect: The fix checks constructBlockDevice for null before creating an ISOFileSystem in InitMemoryForGameISO and Load_PSP_ELF_PBP.
reason: The unchecked constructBlockDevice call existed before the change in Load_PSP_ISO (the change only moved it), and the ELF/PBP path is untouched by the change.

defect: stepVideo now calls updateSwsFormat before the m_pFrame/m_pFrameRGB null checks, and updateSwsFormat dereferences m_pCodecCtx (possibly null, with m_sws_fmt possibly uninitialized) without checking it.
reason: The fix adds the m_pCodecCtx check in updateSwsFormat and early returns in stepVideo, repairing the null-dereference crash this change introduced; setVideoDim's own null check shows the context can be null.

defect: In non-through mode the change doubles the UV offsets uvscaleoff[2] and uvscaleoff[3] along with the scales.
reason: The fix removes exactly the doubling of the offsets and keeps the doubled scales; seeing it requires the shader formula uv * scale + offset.

defect: Removing _XBOX turned '!(MOBILE_DEVICE || _XBOX) || _DEBUG' into '!(MOBILE_DEVICE || _DEBUG)', which disables file and console logging in desktop debug builds and no longer matches the destructor's guard.
reason: The fix restores '!defined(MOBILE_DEVICE) || defined(_DEBUG)' in both places; the logic error is visible in the diff.

defect: The fix capitalizes the libretro core option labels and values.
reason: Cosmetic label change, not the repair of a defect.

defect: The fix adds (int) casts on result.length() in the memcpy and the return to silence a warning.
reason: Warning-only fix with unchanged behaviour, and the return line predates the change.

defect: The new mirror loop reads b from line[x * 3 + 1] instead of line[x * 3 + 2], corrupting the blue channel.
reason: The fix ('Fix camera mirroring color issue') corrects this index; the typo is directly visible in the diff.

defect: The new k0 block writes the initial stack at k0+0xc0 and the thread UID at the misaligned k0+0xca, instead of the UID at 0xc0 and the stack at 0xc8.
reason: The fix swaps these to UID at 0xc0 and initialStack at 0xc8; the misaligned 32-bit write at 0xca is a visible red flag in the diff.

defect: GetModifTime passes &buf.st_mtime of struct stat64 to localtime_r, which does not compile on Android where st_mtime is not a time_t.
reason: The fix ('Fix Android build cast error') changes exactly this line, repairing the Android build broken by this change; the type mismatch depends on the platform's stat64.

defect: The change calls glEnable/glDisable(GL_TEXTURE_2D), which is not a valid capability in OpenGL ES 2.0 (GL_INVALID_ENUM) and has no effect on the shader pipeline.
reason: The same author removes exactly these calls two days later; the defect is minor (an invalid GL call rather than a visible wrong result) but lies wholly in the added lines.

defect: The fix stops hleLogDebugOrWarn/hleLogDebugOrError from evaluating the res argument several times by choosing the level inside hleDoLog.
reason: The macros already repeated res in the level expression before this change, which only removed the retmask argument.

defect: In this file the fix only drops a comment and moves a blank line in BeginHostFrame.
reason: No code changes in this file, so nothing is repaired here.

defect: The fix writes the specular colour to ub_lights.materialSpecular instead of materialEmissive, inverts the Y-flip condition and reworks uniform dirtying.
reason: The specular-into-emissive line was already wrong before the change, which only renamed ub_lightGlobal to ub_lights, and the other fixed code is not part of this change.
